phase: Phase 3: Advantage Games Completion and Scoring Contract
summary: Phase 3 Green passes security and data-handling review. The shared packages/domain/src/games/ module rejects client-supplied XP via .strict(), computes XP server-side, asserts games:complete before any DB work, uses UUID-shaped idempotencyKey for SELECT-before-INSERT fire-once semantics, bounds accuracy to canonical 0..1, and avoids SQL injection and secret logging. The standalone apps/advantage-games route validates through the same schema and does not persist to a real database. Tenant scoping for xpLogs correctly uses db.unscoped() because the table is REFERENTIAL. All targeted tests pass with 0 lint and 0 type-check errors.
nonblocking_findings: NB-1: HauntedLibraryGame.tsx initializes one idempotencyKey per component mount and reuses it across game restarts. A second completion in the same session would be treated as a duplicate. Regenerate the key at the start of each new game in Phase 5+.
NB-2: plan.md documented vocabulary-games gate with extra -- that fails literally. Corrected in commit 81c54fec to pnpm --filter vocabulary-games test --testPathPatterns=...
NB-3: xpLogs is REFERENTIAL in tenant registry. recordGameCompletion and getGameCompletions use db.unscoped() and scope by authenticated userId only. Tenant-safe persistence is deferred to Phase 4.
evidence: gameCompletionInputSchema uses .strict() and rejects unknown keys including xp, dragonCount, bossPower.
accuracy is z.number().min(0).max(1) enforcing fractional canonical unit.
idempotencyKey is z.string().uuid(); recordGameCompletion performs SELECT-before-INSERT on game:<gameType>:<idempotencyKey> and returns duplicate:true with xpEarned:0 on retry.
recordGameCompletion calls assertCan(user, 'games:complete', tenant) before validating input or touching the database.
calculateGameXP is a pure function computing Math.min(10, base + bonus). No client XP accepted.
completeRoute.ts has no db parameter and performs no persistence; it only parses body, computes XP, and returns mock JSON.
All Drizzle queries use typed column references and eq()/and() builders; no raw SQL or string interpolation.
No secrets, tokens, or environment variables are logged in new domain files or route.
